quizData.question: What is a benefit of composing composables (calling one composable inside another)?

options.text: It allows building complex logic from smaller, reusable pieces

quizData.explanation: Composing composables enables you to combine smaller, focused pieces of logic into larger, more powerful ones, promoting reusability.
